findings.title: Migration crashes when embed_category is unset
findings.body: The data migration always does execute(...)[0]['id'] on the embed_category join. If that site setting was never saved, or its value does not exactly match a category name, the query returns no row, [0] is nil, and the migration raises NoMethodError before the uncategorized_category_id fallback. Any upgrade that has not configured embed_category will fail while creating embeddable_hosts and will not reach the DELETE of the old settings.

findings.title: Migrated hosts are inserted raw and unescaped
findings.body: Existing embeddable_hosts values are interpolated into INSERT with '#{h}' and are not normalized. A host containing a quote breaks or injects SQL during upgrade. Values stored as 'http://example.com' or with a path (which the old SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host? accepted) are saved verbatim, while EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? compares URI#host to the column, so previously working embeds stop matching after migration.

findings.title: PostCreator is given a category id as a name
findings.body: Import now passes category: eh.try(:category_id). PostCreator's :category option is a category name (it looks up Category by name); the numeric id belongs in category_id. The lookup misses, so newly imported embed topics are not filed in the host's category and fall through to the default/uncategorized category. The per-host category feature this PR adds does not take effect on create.

findings.title: embed: :ids cannot read ids from OpenStruct
findings.body: has_many :embeddable_hosts, embed: :ids makes the serializer call embeddable_host_ids. Admin::EmbeddingController builds an OpenStruct with only id and embeddable_hosts, so that method is missing and returns nil via method_missing. The customize/embedding JSON therefore has no host ids to hydrate, and the admin UI loads with an empty host list even when rows exist.

findings.title: Allowlist host compare is case-sensitive on the URL side
findings.body: record_for_host sets host = uri.host and queries lower(host) = ? without downcasing the bound value. A referer or embed URL whose host differs only in case (EvilTrout.com vs stored eviltrout.com) does not match, so EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? denies a host that was saved and comments/import are rejected.

findings.title: Missing host records raise instead of 404
findings.body: update and destroy load the row with where(id:).first and then call save_host or destroy with no nil check. An unknown id makes host nil and raises NoMethodError (500) rather than a not-found response. save_host also assumes params[:embeddable_host] is present, so a body without that key 500s the same way.

findings.title: Plural _ids hydration assumes a non-null array
findings.body: The new *_ids branch always calls obj[k].map. If a rest payload includes a key such as color_ids or embeddable_host_ids set to null (or any non-array), hydration throws and the whole find/findAll fails. This is a shared store path, not limited to embedding, so any serializer that emits a null has-many id list now breaks client loads.

findings.title: Category and embeddable-host fabricators were swapped
findings.body: category_fabricator.rb now only defines Fabricator(:embeddable_host), and the category, diff_category, happy_category, and private_category fabricators were moved into embeddable_host_fabricator.rb. Anything that loads fabricators by the category file, or a later cleanup that deletes the misnamed file, drops Fabricate(:category) and breaks the suite, including the new embed specs that depend on it.
